maria (eng-security): heads up — we just got a DSAR for a EU customer asking for deletion of embeddings and any backup snapshots. they included proof of identity.
jon (privacy): ok. do we know which bucket / keystore? any cross-region replicas?
maria (eng-security): looks like embeddings S3 prefix eu-west-1://redwood-embeddings/customer-1234/, encrypted with kms:alias/rdw-eu. there are nightly snapshots in us-west-2 as well (replication).
lee (eng-platform): replication means copies encrypted with the same key alias but different kms-cmk ARNs. deletion needs to remove live objects + snapshot records + ensure rewrapping isn't accidentally restoring.
sara (legal): we may need a retention exception if there's lawful hold, but requester provided notarized proof. privacy can request erase after validation.
jon (privacy): i'll validate identity. once validated, what's the safe delete flow? i don't want to break ongoing ops or lose forensics for potential vuln triage.
maria (eng-security): propose this sequence:
  1) create a short-lived service account `dsar-erase-runner` with scoped role (s3:DeleteObject, s3:ListBucket) and kms:Decrypt/Describe on the specific CMKs.
  2) snapshot metadata -> mark snapshot as "erasure-in-progress" in the delete queue (so any restore jobs skip it).
  3) run delete job that deletes live prefix, then deletes snapshots, then requests KMS scheduleKeyDeletion for ephemeral keys if child keys used (NOT root CMK).
  4) publish audit events to audit-log cluster with retention 7 years (append-only) and send a receipt to requester.
lee (eng-platform): small nit — we can't schedule deletion on account CMKs. need to instead rotate and revoke grants for service accounts. also cross-region copies must be deleted via the replica region's service account or via S3 Replication configuration disabling.
maria (eng-security): good catch. update: rotate data-encrypting keys and revoke grants. for snapshots, we'll call the snapshot-service API to remove copies then remove underlying objects.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: runbook/dsar/erase-procedure v2 invoked by maria
jon (privacy): audit logs — can we include proof package with signed timestamps, KMS key-id used, and object manifests? that's what legal wants for evidence.
maria (eng-security): yes. we'll bundle: object list, replication-status, KMS-key-ARNs, deletion-ops logs, and a signed event envelope from the audit service. i will add a minimal data-minimization note: we only include object keys + sha256, no raw embeddings content.
sara (legal): confirm we redact any unrelated PII from manifests. good that you're hashing.
lee (eng-platform): one more thing — RBAC change: privacy needs ability to request deletes and view audit receipts but not raw S3 access. recommend a new role `privacy.cleanup` that maps to an internal workflow token. it triggers the erase job but does not grant s3/kms rights directly.
maria (eng-security): agree. we'll implement role + workflow token TTL 30m, and require two-person approval (privacy + eng-security) to start live erase.
jon (privacy): timeline? i have identity validated now.
maria (eng-security): i'll kick off approvals. expected time ~2h for EU live delete + 6h including snapshot GC across regions. i'll post final receipt here when done.
lee (eng-platform): mark this in the retention-exceptions tracker (internal link: https://internal.redwood/retention-exceptions/queue/4509871234) and bump observability alert to monitor error rates of snapshot-service.
maria (eng-security): copying commands we will run (internal-only):
```
# mark snapshot
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $WF_TOKEN" \
  https://internal.redwood/snapshot-service/v1/mark_erase \
  -d '{"snapshot_id":"snap-20240501-cust1234","reason":"DSAR erase","initiator":"maria"}'

# delete prefix
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-embeddings/customer-1234/ --recursive --region eu-west-1
```
jon (privacy): perfect. thanks. please also capture the grant revocation steps so we can show access was removed.
maria (eng-security): will do. if anything blocks (kms grant errors, replication lock), i'll escalate and create an incident page. tagging @sara for legal approval when logs ready.
sara (legal): approved to proceed under provided proof. hold any legal holds and notify me immediately if a 3rd party subpoena surfaces.
maria (eng-security): running approvals now. will update with final audit receipt here. :lock_with_ink_pen:
ops-bot: Approval completed: 2-person check passed. job queued.
maria (eng-security): update 1 — live EU objects deleted at 4509871299, snapshot-service reports replica delete queued for us-west-2.
lee (eng-platform): received queued delete. monitoring replication lag — currently 4m.
maria (eng-security): final — us-west-2 replicas removed and audit package uploaded to evidence vault (evidence-id: ev-4509871234). sending receipt to requester.
jon (privacy): received. thanks everyone. filing closure ticket.
sara (legal): receipt reviewed. closing with note: no retention exception needed.
